meta.task: I want to listen to music

defs.name: Music Player: Now Playing Deck
defs.genInstructions: Build the central playback deck with large album artwork, track/artist/album titles, a scrubbable seek bar with elapsed/total time, transport controls (play/pause, next, previous, shuffle, repeat), volume slider with mute, and a like/favorite toggle. It is the authoritative playback state owner that other panels read from and write to.
defs.role: The system's playback engine surface and single source of truth for the current track, playback position, and volume, driving the queue, visualizer, and lyrics panels.

effectors.name: Music Player: Library Browser Grid
effectors.description: When the user double-clicks a track or presses play on an album/playlist card, the browser emits the selected track object (id, title, artist, album, artwork URL, duration, audio source) and the deck loads it, resets the seek bar to 0:00, and begins playback immediately.

effectors.name: Music Player: Play Queue Side Panel
effectors.description: When the user clicks a queued item or the queue advances after a track ends, the panel emits the newly active queue index and its track metadata; the deck loads and plays that track and highlights it as current. The panel also supplies the next/previous targets consumed when the deck's skip buttons are pressed.

targets.name: Music Player: Play Queue Side Panel
targets.description: The deck broadcasts current track id, playing/paused state, and end-of-track events; the queue highlights the matching row, shows an animated equalizer icon while playing, and auto-advances its pointer to the next item (respecting shuffle/repeat mode also broadcast by the deck).

targets.name: Music Player: Audio Visualizer Panel
targets.description: The deck streams live playback state — frequency/amplitude data, play/pause, and current time — so the visualizer animates only while audio plays, freezes on pause, and re-themes its colors from the current track's artwork palette.

targets.name: Music Player: Lyrics And Track Info Panel
targets.description: On track change the deck sends full track metadata (title, artist, album, year, artwork) and on every timeupdate it sends the current playback position so the panel loads matching lyrics/credits and auto-scrolls to highlight the active lyric line.

defs.name: Music Player: Library Browser Grid
defs.genInstructions: Build a scrollable library browser with a search field, filter chips (artists, albums, playlists, genres), sort control, and a responsive grid of album/playlist cards plus an expandable track list with hover play and 'add to queue' actions. It is how the user discovers and starts music.
defs.role: The discovery surface of the UI, letting the user search and browse the catalog and feed chosen tracks into the playback deck and queue.

targets.name: Music Player: Now Playing Deck
targets.description: Double-clicking a track or pressing a card's play button emits the full track object (id, title, artist, album, artwork, duration, source) and the deck immediately loads and plays it.

targets.name: Music Player: Play Queue Side Panel
targets.description: Clicking 'add to queue' on a track, album, or playlist emits an ordered array of track objects that the queue appends to its list; playing an album outright replaces the queue contents with that album's tracklist in order.

defs.name: Music Player: Play Queue Side Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a vertical side panel listing upcoming tracks with drag-to-reorder handles, remove buttons, a 'now playing' highlighted row, queue duration summary, and clear-queue / save-as-playlist actions. It manages playback order for the deck.
defs.role: The ordered playlist state manager that determines what plays next and reflects the deck's current position.

effectors.name: Music Player: Now Playing Deck
effectors.description: Receives current track id, play/pause state, shuffle/repeat mode, and track-ended events; highlights the active row with an equalizer animation and advances its internal pointer accordingly.

effectors.name: Music Player: Library Browser Grid
effectors.description: Receives arrays of track objects from 'add to queue' actions (appended to the end) or from album/playlist play actions (replacing the whole queue).

targets.name: Music Player: Now Playing Deck
targets.description: Clicking a queue row, or reordering/removing items that change the next-up track, emits the target track object and queue index; the deck loads and plays it and uses the queue order to resolve next/previous skips.

defs.name: Music Player: Audio Visualizer Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build an animated canvas visualizer (frequency bars or waveform) that reacts to live playback amplitude, with a style selector and a color palette derived from the current artwork. Purely aesthetic feedback for the listening experience.
defs.role: The ambient visual feedback surface that makes the deck's live playback state visible and atmospheric.

effectors.name: Music Player: Now Playing Deck
effectors.description: Receives frequency/amplitude data, play/pause state, and the current track's artwork color palette; animates bars in real time while playing, idles or fades when paused, and recolors on track change.

defs.name: Music Player: Lyrics And Track Info Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a panel with time-synced scrolling lyrics that highlight the active line, plus a tabbed section showing track credits, album, year, genre and artist blurb. Gives context on whatever is currently playing.
defs.role: The contextual detail surface that expands on the deck's current track with synced lyrics and metadata.

effectors.name: Music Player: Now Playing Deck
effectors.description: Receives full track metadata on track change and continuous playback position updates; loads the matching lyrics, auto-scrolls and highlights the line matching the current timestamp, and repopulates the info tab.
